sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日于 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家届时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, Democrats forced a shutdown by saying no budget deal without a DACA deal.
sentences.zh: 今天，民主党人迫使政府关门，他们表示没有 DACA 协议，就不会达成预算协议。

sentences.en: Republicans have refused to end the shutdown by saying no DACA deal without a budget deal.
sentences.zh: 共和党人拒绝结束政府关门，他们表示没有预算协议，就不会达成 DACA 协议。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: government is in a stalemate.
sentences.zh: 政府陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: It's Monday, January 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是 1 月 22 日，星期一。

sentences.en: We begin with those high-stakes negotiations underway at this hour.
sentences.zh: 我们首先关注目前正在进行的高风险谈判。

sentences.en: Will there be a government shutdown or an 11th-hour deal here?
sentences.zh: 这里究竟会发生政府关门，还是会在最后一刻达成协议？

sentences.en: So the big question as Friday began was, would there be some negotiations, some progress that would lead Senate Democrats to decide,
sentences.zh: 因此，周五刚开始时最大的问题是：是否会有一些谈判、一些进展，能让参议院民主党人决定——

sentences.en: OK, fine, we will go along with voting for something that will keep the government open?
sentences.zh: 好吧，没关系，我们同意投票支持一项能让政府保持开放的法案？

sentences.en: Thomas Kaplan has been covering the negotiations.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·卡普兰一直在报道这些谈判。

sentences.en: The possibility of a breakthrough there seemed to come when President Trump invited the Senate Democratic leader, Chuck Schumer, to the White House to meet.
sentences.zh: 当总统特朗普邀请参议院民主党领袖查克·舒默前往白宫会面时，似乎出现了一线突破的可能。

sentences.en: President Trump stepping in today with an unexpected invitation to the Senate's top Democrat, Chuck Schumer, to come to the White House.
sentences.zh: 总统特朗普今天突然发出意外邀请，请参议院最高民主党人查克·舒默前往白宫。

sentences.en: Over cheeseburgers, they talked about the issues that were outstanding.
sentences.zh: 伴随着芝士汉堡，他们讨论了尚未解决的议题。

sentences.en: This afternoon, in my heart, I thought we might have a deal tonight.
sentences.zh: 今天下午，我内心以为我们今晚就能达成协议。

sentences.en: That was how far we'd come.
sentences.zh: 我们当时离达成协议已经这么近了。

sentences.en: That's how positive our discussion felt.
sentences.zh: 我们的讨论感觉是多么积极。

sentences.en: We had a good meeting.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了一次很好的会面。

sentences.en: But there's been plenty of arguing back and forth over what exactly played out in that meeting.
sentences.zh: 但关于那次会面中究竟发生了什么，双方有很多来来回回的争论。

sentences.en: The way Senator Schumer recalls it, he agreed to fund the border wall that President Trump wants to build along the southern border with Mexico.
sentences.zh: 在参议院领袖舒默的回忆中，他同意资助特朗普总统希望在美墨南部边境修建的边境墙。

sentences.en: I essentially agreed to give the president something he has said he wants in exchange for something we both want.
sentences.zh: 我基本上同意给总统一些他一直想要的东西，以此来换取我们双方都想要的东西。

sentences.en: In exchange for the president agreeing to an immigration measure that would protect the young undocumented immigrants known as DREAMers.
sentences.zh: 作为交换，总统同意一项移民措施，以保护被称为“追梦人”的年轻无证移民。

sentences.en: It is true that Chuck Schumer made what I consider to be a bold and important concession
sentences.zh: 诚然，查克·舒默做出了我认为堪称大胆而重要的让步，

sentences.en: and said, yes, we'll go forward with the wall as long as we do this in a responsible fashion.
sentences.zh: 并表示，是的，只要我们以负责任的方式处理此事，我们就会推进建墙。

sentences.en: We had a substantial commitment.
sentences.zh: 我们达成了实质性的承诺。

sentences.en: Well, I'm not going to quote numbers because I don't think that's my place to do it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我不打算引用具体的数字，因为我认为这不该由我来做。

sentences.en: But I can tell you it was a substantial commitment to the president.
sentences.zh: 但我可以告诉你，这对总统来说是一个实质性的承诺。

sentences.en: If this is going to have to be a compromise where Democrats give something and Republicans
sentences.zh: 如果这必须是一场妥协，即民主党人做出一些让步，而共和党人

sentences.en: give something at the end of the day, spending some money on a wall that, granted, Democrats
sentences.zh: 最终也做出让步的话，那么花钱建一堵墙——尽管民主党人

sentences.en: say is unnecessary and is a waste of money and isn't the best way to address securing the border.
sentences.zh: 认为这是不必要的、是浪费金钱，也不是解决边境安全问题的最佳方式——

sentences.en: Or maybe that was something that they could swallow for being able to address the fate of we're talking hundreds of thousands of people.
sentences.zh: 或者也许这是他们为了解决几十万人的命运而能够咽下的一口气。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: You want to build this monument to stupidity?
sentences.zh: 你们想建造这座愚蠢的纪念碑吗？

sentences.en: You want to waste and you insist upon wasting $20 billion?
sentences.zh: 你们想要浪费并且坚持要浪费 200 亿美元吗？

sentences.en: Then I say free to DREAMers.
sentences.zh: 那我要求释放追梦人。

sentences.en: So is the border wall just kind of one aspect of an immigration plan that isn't really about
sentences.zh: 那么，边境墙只是移民计划的一个方面吗？这个计划实际上并不像取消签证抽签或总统所称的“连锁移民”那样，

sentences.en: how we approach immigration in this country in the way that doing away with visa lottery or what the president calls chain migration is, it seems like something they don't mind
sentences.zh: 关乎我们国家对待移民的方式。这似乎是他们不介意

sentences.en: giving away since it's not an essential question of American immigration and how we approach it.
sentences.zh: 放弃的东西，因为它并非美国移民问题及其处理方式的核心核心问题。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我认为是这样的。

sentences.en: And being a waste of money is sort of a different question from making significant changes to the immigration system broadly.
sentences.zh: 而且，浪费金钱与对移民系统进行广泛的重大变革，在某种程度上是两个不同的问题。

sentences.en: Yes, Democrats think the wall is not the way to go, but perhaps spending some money on something
sentences.zh: 是的，民主党人认为修墙不是正确途径，但也许在他们认为不明智的事情上花一些钱，

sentences.en: they think is unwise would be something they could swallow to get what they really want.
sentences.zh: 是他们为了得到自己真正想要的东西而能够咽下的妥协。

sentences.en: And as despicable as it is, as hurtful as it is to people like me and others in this country, we are ready to sacrifice that so that DREAMers can have freedom in this country.
sentences.zh: 尽管这令人鄙视，尽管这对我和这个国家的其他人来说是如此痛苦，但我们准备做出牺牲，好让追梦人在这个国家获得自由。

sentences.en: So things are looking pretty good coming out of this meeting between Schumer and Trump in the White House on Friday.
sentences.zh: 所以，从周五舒默和特朗普在白宫的这次会面来看，情况看起来相当不错。

sentences.en: The Democrats, under this plan that the two are talking through, would get a deal on DACA.
sentences.zh: 根据两人正在讨论的这项计划，民主党人将获得一份关于 DACA 的协议。

sentences.en: And the president would get funding for his wall, which he has promised since he started running for president back in 2016.
sentences.zh: 而总统将获得他自 2016 年竞选总统以来一直承诺的建墙资金。

sentences.en: So then what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, the way Schumer describes it, the president backed away from this tentative agreement.
sentences.zh: 嗯，按舒默的说法，总统背离了这份初步协议。

sentences.en: The president suggested, let's do it by Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 总统建议：我们周二晚上搞定吧。

sentences.en: We said, great.
sentences.zh: 我们说：太好了。

sentences.en: Several hours later, he called back.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，他又打电话来了。

sentences.en: He said, so I hear we have a three-week deal.
sentences.zh: 他说：我听说我们达成了一个为期三周的协议。

sentences.en: I said, no, Mr. President, no one's even talked to me about a three-week deal.
sentences.zh: 我说：不，总统先生，根本没有人跟我谈过三周的协议。

sentences.en: I heard that's the deal.
sentences.zh: 我听说这就是协议。

sentences.en: I said, no one's talked to me.
sentences.zh: 我说：没人跟我谈过。

sentences.en: I called Leader Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 我打电话给众议院民主党领袖佩洛西。

sentences.en: No one had talked to her.
sentences.zh: 也没有人跟她谈过。

sentences.en: Then, a few hours later, they called back again.
sentences.zh: 然后，几个小时后，他们又打来电话。

sentences.en: Well, we're going to need this, this, this, this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们需要这个、这个、这个、这个。

sentences.en: In addition, things, it was General Kelly, that they knew were far, far right.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，还有凯利将军提出的那些他们明知极为右翼的事项。

sentences.en: After the president and Schumer seemed to have the basics of a deal, the White House chief
sentences.zh: 在总统和舒默似乎就协议基础达成一致后，被视为移民问题强硬派的白宫办公厅

sentences.en: of staff, John Kelly, who is seen as a hardliner on immigration, called Schumer and outlined a whole list of objections to what had been sketched out earlier in the day.
sentences.zh: 主任约翰·凯利给舒默打了个电话，列举了对当天早些时候草拟的内容的一系列反对意见。

sentences.en: And as the night went on, it was clear this had unraveled.
sentences.zh: 随着夜色渐深，很明显这一切都破裂了。

sentences.en: Whatever tentative deal had been sketched out wasn't tatters.
sentences.zh: 无论之前草拟了什么初步协议，都已经支离破碎。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: There are 10 seconds left, officially, until the top of the hour, until there is an official government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 距离整点、距离政府正式关门，官方倒计时还剩 10 秒。

sentences.en: Your lawmakers now are still working to try to come up with something.
sentences.zh: 你们的议员现在仍在努力想办法达成某种方案。

sentences.en: But obviously, that will be too late.
sentences.zh: 但显然，那将为时已晚。

sentences.en: So here's the breaking news.
sentences.zh: 以下是突发新闻。

sentences.en: It is midnight.
sentences.zh: 已经是午夜了。

sentences.en: No deal.
sentences.zh: 没有达成协议。

sentences.en: As a result, at midnight on Friday night, the government shut down.
sentences.zh: 因此，在周五午夜，政府关门了。

sentences.en: The shutdown of the federal government is now beginning.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府的关门现在开始了。

sentences.en: The Democrats had to really unify to make this happen, right?
sentences.zh: 民主党人必须真正团结起来才能促成此事，对吧？

sentences.en: They almost unanimously had to agree to hold out and let the government shut down if they didn't get what they wanted, primarily some sort of deal on immigration.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎是以全票一致同意坚持到底，如果得不到他们想要的东西——主要是某种关于移民的协议——就任由政府关门。

sentences.en: And they embraced all the political risks that come with being that unified and triggering a shutdown.
sentences.zh: 他们承担了保持这种团结并引发政府关门所带来的所有政治风险。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And this was something that I think a lot of people, myself included, were really skeptical about.
sentences.zh: 我认为很多人（包括我自己）对此都抱有极大的怀疑态度。

sentences.en: There are a bunch of Senate Democrats who are up for re-election this year in states that
sentences.zh: 有许多参议院民主党人今年要在特朗普总统在 2016 年获胜的州

sentences.en: President Trump won in 2016.
sentences.zh: 竞选连任。

sentences.en: There was a big political risk to be seen as voting to shut the government down.
sentences.zh: 被视为投票导致政府关门，存在着巨大的政治风险。

sentences.en: And it was a big question mark whether a lot of these Democratic senators would be willing to go along with that.
sentences.zh: 许多这样的民主党参议员是否愿意随波逐流，是一个巨大的问号。

sentences.en: Certainly, there were a number of Senate Democrats, particularly some of the most liberal members who really wanted to push this issue and demand a solution on DACA.
sentences.zh: 当然，有许多参议院民主党人，尤其是那些真正希望推动这一议题并要求解决 DACA 问题的最自由派成员，

sentences.en: But the vast majority of Democratic senators stuck together with this position that this stopgap bill that did not address immigration was unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 但绝大多数民主党参议员团结一致，坚守这一立场：不解决移民问题的临时拨款法案是不可接受的。

sentences.en: Sarah Huckabee Sanders overnight writing this in a statement, Senate Democrats own the Schumer shutdown.
sentences.zh: 萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯连夜在声明中写道：参议院民主党人要为舒默引发的关门承担责任。

sentences.en: We will not negotiate the status of unlawful immigrants while Democrats hold our lawful citizens hostage over their reckless demands.
sentences.zh: 当民主党人因其鲁莽的要求而将我们的合法公民作为人质时，我们不会就非法移民的身份进行谈判。

sentences.en: This is the behavior of obstructionist losers, not legislators.
sentences.zh: 这是奉行阻挠主义的失败者的行为，而不是立法者的行为。

sentences.en: At midnight, the government shut down.
sentences.zh: 午夜时分，政府关门了。

sentences.en: The blame game started.
sentences.zh: 指责游戏开始了。

sentences.en: And since then, it's been a lot of finger pointing between the two parties.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，两党之间一直在互相指责。

sentences.en: And so the Republicans almost immediately are pointing at the Democrats as having shut the
sentences.zh: 因此，共和党人几乎立刻将矛头指向民主党人，指责他们因为

sentences.en: government down over, in their words, an unrelated issue not tied to funding the government, which is DACA.
sentences.zh: 用他们的话说是一个与政府资金无关的议题（即 DACA），而导致政府关门。

sentences.en: Senate Democrats led by Chuck Schumer, they're the ones to blame tonight.
sentences.zh: 以查克·舒默为首的参议院民主党人，今晚该承担责任的就是他们。

sentences.en: They are the ones who really, in reality, are putting illegal immigrants before you, the
sentences.zh: 他们才是真正将非法移民置于你们——

sentences.en: American people.
sentences.zh: 美国人民——之上的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: DACA is in place until March.
sentences.zh: DACA 将持续到三月份。

sentences.en: It is not that urgent.
sentences.zh: 情况并没有那么紧急。

sentences.en: How are Democrats pointing the finger in the other direction at Republicans?
sentences.zh: 民主党人又是如何将矛头指向共和党人的呢？

sentences.en: So Democrats are very quick to point out that the Republican Party controls the White
sentences.zh: 因此，民主党人非常迅速地指出，共和党控制了白宫

sentences.en: House, the House, and the Senate.
sentences.zh: 、众议院和参议院。

sentences.en: The Republicans are in control of every branch of government.
sentences.zh: 共和党人控制了政府的每一个分支。

sentences.en: The presidency, of course, the House, the Senate, through their nominees, the Supreme
sentences.zh: 总统职位，当然还有众议院、参议院，并通过他们的提名人控制了最高

sentences.en: Court.
sentences.zh: 法院。

sentences.en: And the Republicans are in complete control of the business that comes before the House and the Senate.
sentences.zh: 而且共和党人完全控制了提交给众议院和参议院的事务。

sentences.en: Another piece of the argument has been focused on President Trump.
sentences.zh: 争论的另一个焦点一直是特朗普总统。

sentences.en: And this is where Schumer and others have said,
sentences.zh: 这也是舒默和其他人说过的话：

sentences.en: The president must take yes for an answer.
sentences.zh: 总统必须把“同意”作为回答。

sentences.en: Until he does, it's the Trump shutdown.
sentences.zh: 在他这么做之前，这就是特朗普造成的关门。

sentences.en: Happy anniversary, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 祝您周年快乐，总统先生。

sentences.en: Your wish came true.
sentences.zh: 您的愿望实现了。

sentences.en: You wanted a shutdown.
sentences.zh: 您想要政府关门。

sentences.en: The Trump shutdown is all yours.
sentences.zh: 这场特朗普关门完全是你们造成的。

sentences.en: It's become this big battle of, is this the Schumer shutdown or the Trump shutdown?
sentences.zh: 这已经变成了一场大战：这究竟是舒默关门，还是特朗普关门？

sentences.en: OMB is preparing for what we're calling the Schumer shutdown.
sentences.zh: 管理和预算办公室正在为我们所称的“舒默关门”做准备。

sentences.en: The Schumer shutdown is completely unnecessary.
sentences.zh: 舒默关门完全是不必要的。

sentences.en: It should be unavoidable.
sentences.zh: 这本应是可以避免的。

sentences.en: Both sides had something they could point to in arguing that the other side was to blame.
sentences.zh: 双方都有可以拿来争辩的论据，以此证明对方才该承担责任。

sentences.en: And that's continued ever since the moment the government shut down.
sentences.zh: 自政府关门那一刻起，这种情况就一直在延续。

sentences.en: It's been public blame shooting in both directions.
sentences.zh: 双方一直在进行公开的相互指责。

sentences.en: So what you're describing is pretty much the impasse for the rest of the weekend, right?
sentences.zh: 所以你所描述的，基本上就是整个周末的僵局，对吧？

sentences.en: Do both sides remain locked in the position of, on the left, Democrats saying, we won't negotiate spending until you solve DACA?
sentences.zh: 双方是否都依然死守立场：左翼的民主党人说“在你们解决 DACA 之前，我们不会就开支进行谈判”？

sentences.en: And on the right, Republicans saying, we won't negotiate DACA until you give us a budget.
sentences.zh: 而右翼的共和党人则说“在你们给我们预算之前，我们不会就 DACA 进行谈判”？

sentences.en: That is the outline, although there has been a bit of a thaw, and this is why there is some reason to be cautiously optimistic that there could be an exit to this crisis.
sentences.zh: 大致情况就是如此，尽管已经出现了一点缓和的迹象，这也是为什么人们有理由抱有谨慎的乐观态度，认为这场危机可能会有出路。

sentences.en: It is back to work at the Capitol and a return to the scene of the shutdown, the political battle for a deal.
sentences.zh: 国会山又恢复了工作，回到了政府关门事发地——为达成协议而展开的政治争斗中。

sentences.en: But will it involve dreamers for the world?
sentences.zh: 但这会把追梦人卷入其中吗？

sentences.en: In Washington, lawmakers appear to be moving toward a deal to end the government shutdown, a live look for you at Capitol Hill, where lawmakers continue to negotiate an end to
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿，议员们似乎正在朝着结束政府关门的协议迈进。为您现场直播国会山的情况，议员们仍在继续谈判以结束

sentences.en: the stalemate.
sentences.zh: 僵局。

sentences.en: A group of moderate senators from both parties met over the weekend to try to chart a path forward, some kind of compromise that would put an end to this.
sentences.zh: 一个由两党温和派参议员组成的小组在周末举行了会晤，试图为前行开辟道路，寻找某种能够结束这一局面的妥协方案。

sentences.en: Neither side would really get what they want in the sense that some kind of compromise would
sentences.zh: 双方都不会真正得到他们想要的，因为某种妥协方案

sentences.en: perhaps involve some kind of commitment that DACA will be addressed in the Senate in the weeks to come, so it would not be an actual deal on immigration.
sentences.zh: 可能包含某种承诺，即参议院将在未来几周内处理 DACA 问题，因此它不会是一项真正的移民协议。

sentences.en: And as part of that, perhaps Democrats would then be willing to vote for a spending bill that would reopen the government for a short period of time, perhaps a couple weeks, and
sentences.zh: 作为其中的一部分，民主党人随后可能愿意投票支持一项在短期内（比如几周内）重新开放政府的支出法案，

sentences.en: end this crisis.
sentences.zh: 从而结束这场危机。

sentences.en: So Democrats would get no guarantee of what would happen in those negotiations if a short-term
sentences.zh: 因此，如果短期

sentences.en: budget deal is passed, just an agreement to keep discussing the future of issues like DACA.
sentences.zh: 预算协议通过，民主党人将无法获得有关这些谈判结果的任何保证，仅仅是达成了一项继续讨论 DACA 等问题未来的协议。

sentences.en: So that's the big question now, is what exactly will this commitment, promise, pledge, whatever you want to call it, on immigration be?
sentences.zh: 所以现在最大的问题是，这个关于移民的承诺、保证、誓言，无论你想怎么称呼它，究竟会是什么？

sentences.en: One obvious issue that comes up here is, so Mitch McConnell, the Senate majority leader, agrees to have a vote on a DACA bill in a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 这里出现的一个显而易见的问题是：参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔同意在几周内就 DACA 法案进行投票。

sentences.en: It doesn't do a heck of a lot of good from a Democratic point of view if that bill passes the Senate, but then is dead on arrival in the House and never goes anywhere.
sentences.zh: 如果该法案在参议院通过，但随后在众议院见光死、哪里也去不了，那么站在民主党的角度来看，这并没有太大用处。

sentences.en: So just a promise to have a vote in the Senate might not be enough in the eyes of some.
sentences.zh: 因此，在某些人看来，仅仅承诺在参议院进行投票可能还不够。

sentences.en: So that's really now the sort of biggest lingering question is what promises or concessions could
sentences.zh: 所以现在真正挥之不去的最大问题是，究竟能做出什么样的承诺或让步

sentences.en: be made on how immigration could be handled in the weeks to come, and will those promises, concessions, be concrete enough to be meaningful to Democrats?
sentences.zh: 关于未来几周将如何处理移民问题，会做出怎样的决策，而那些承诺和让步是否足够具体，对民主党人来说有实际意义？

sentences.en: I'm struck by the fact that all of this uncertainty in Congress seems to come back to these meetings
sentences.zh: 让我感触深的是，国会中所有这些不确定性似乎都回到了这些会议上

sentences.en: at the White House and what happens when members of Congress go there to try to work out a deal on immigration that Trump will support.
sentences.zh: 在白宫举行，以及当国会议员去那里试图达成特朗普会支持的移民协议时所发生的情况。

sentences.en: This all started last week when Dick Durbin and Lindsey Graham thought they had a deal with
sentences.zh: 这一切始于上周，当时迪克·德宾和林赛·格雷厄姆认为他们已经与

sentences.en: the president, and then it seems Trump's aide, Stephen Miller, stepped in and the deal was off.
sentences.zh: 总统达成了协议，然后似乎是特朗普的助手斯蒂芬·米勒介入了，协议便告吹了。

sentences.en: Now we have reports that the president's chief of staff, John Kelly, played a similar role in stepping in and calling off a deal with Chuck Schumer on Friday.
sentences.zh: 现在有报道称，总统办公厅主任约翰·凯利在周五介入并取消与查克·舒默的协议时也起到了类似的作用。

sentences.en: And I think it's a real point of frustration on Capitol Hill in dealing with the White House and the president, which is certainly something that Schumer and Democrats have said.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是国会山在与白宫和总统打交道时的一个真正的挫折点，舒默和民主党人对此也确实有所表态。

sentences.en: How do you negotiate with someone who agrees to something, commits to something, and then that agreement, that commitment suddenly is wiped away?
sentences.zh: 你如何和一个同意某事、承诺某事，然后又突然将该协议和承诺一笔勾销的人谈判？

sentences.en: What's even more frustrating than President Trump's intransigence is the way he seems amenable to these compromises before completely switching positions and backing off.
sentences.zh: 比特朗普总统的顽固更让人沮丧的是，他在完全改变立场并退缩之前，似乎对这些妥协表现得很温和。

sentences.en: Negotiating with President Trump is like negotiating with Jell-O.
sentences.zh: 与特朗普总统谈判就像与果冻谈判一样。

sentences.en: Even today, a Republican, Lindsey Graham, complained about Stephen Miller.
sentences.zh: 就在今天，共和党人林赛·格雷厄姆抱怨了斯蒂芬·米勒。

sentences.en: I've talked with the president.
sentences.zh: 我和总统谈过。

sentences.en: His heart is right on this issue.
sentences.zh: 在这个问题上他的内心是正确的。

sentences.en: I think he's got a good understanding of what will sell.
sentences.zh: 我认为他很清楚什么行得通。

sentences.en: And every time we have a proposal, it is only yanked back by staff members.
sentences.zh: 而我们每次提出方案，都只会被工作人员粗暴地撤回。

sentences.en: As long as Stephen Miller is in charge of negotiating immigration, we're going nowhere.
sentences.zh: 只要斯蒂芬·米勒负责移民谈判，我们就一事无成。

sentences.en: He's been an outlier for years.
sentences.zh: 多年来他一直是个异类。

sentences.en: Help us make sense of something.
sentences.zh: 帮我们理清一件事。

sentences.en: President Trump started all this by rescinding DACA and sending it to Congress and telling Congress,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统通过废除DACA并将其交由国会处理来开启了这一切，他告诉国会，

sentences.en: this is yours to solve, and indicating very clearly that he wanted to protect the dreamers.
sentences.zh: 这是你们需要解决的问题，并且非常明确地表示他希望保护逐梦者。

sentences.en: But at every step along the way, it's felt like the president himself has blocked Congress's effort to do just that.
sentences.zh: 但在此过程中的每一步，都让人觉得是总统本人在阻挠国会实现这一目标的努力。

sentences.en: How do you make sense of that?
sentences.zh: 你如何理解这一点？

sentences.en: Well, I think that's why there's so much frustration in Congress, certainly among Democrats.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想这就是为什么国会中会有如此多的沮丧情绪，尤其是民主党人。

sentences.en: They say the president created this crisis.
sentences.zh: 他们说这场危机是总统制造的。

sentences.en: He set in motion this entire saga.
sentences.zh: 他开启了这整个事件。

sentences.en: He created this uncertainty for hundreds of thousands of people.
sentences.zh: 他给数十万人制造了这种不确定性。

sentences.en: And ever since then, it's been hard to pin down what exactly he wants.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，人们就很难确切捉摸他到底想要什么。

sentences.en: I think a big reason that we are in this position now is that lack of trust and the fact that lawmakers struggled to figure out what the president wanted them to do.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们现在处于这种境地的一个主要原因，就是缺乏信任，以及议员们难以弄清楚总统到底想让他们做什么。

sentences.en: The president sent different signals at different times, and Democrats really questioned whether something would actually get done on this issue.
sentences.zh: 总统在不同时期发出了不同的信号，民主党人确实在质疑在这个问题上是否真的能有所作为。

sentences.en: And I think that motivated a lot of people to really force the issue and say, we need to take a firm stand.
sentences.zh: 我想这促使许多人真正去推动这个问题并表示，我们需要采取坚定的立场。

sentences.en: And if it means shutting down the government, then that's something that they felt comfortable doing.
sentences.zh: 如果这意味着关门政府，那么这是他们觉得可以接受的做法。

sentences.en: Tom, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Sunday night, Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell announced that he was delaying a late-night vote on a temporary spending bill until today at noon, a signal that the plan
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔宣布，他将把关于临时支出法案的深夜投票推迟到今天中午，这表明

sentences.en: being worked out by moderate senators was progressing.
sentences.zh: 温和派参议员正在制定的计划取得了进展。

sentences.en: It would be my intention to proceed to legislation that would address DACA, border security, and related issues.
sentences.zh: 我的意图是推进旨在解决DACA、边境安全及相关问题的立法。

sentences.en: In a gesture to lawmakers who are demanding that the Senate address the fate of the dreamers,
sentences.zh: 为了向那些要求参议院解决逐梦者命运的议员们示好，

sentences.en: McConnell said he planned to move ahead with immigration legislation next month, if the issue had not already been resolved.
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔表示，如果这个问题尚未解决，他计划在下个月推进移民立法。

sentences.en: So let's step back from the brink.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们从悬崖边缘退一步。

sentences.en: Let's stop victimizing the American people and get back to work on their behalf.
sentences.zh: 让我们停止将美国人民置于受害者地位，重新开始为他们的利益工作。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载纽约时报应用时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是纽约时报的订阅者，今天就下载时报应用并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, Taliban militants attacked a luxury hotel in Afghanistan's capital city of Kabul, leaving at least 18 dead, nearly all of them foreigners.
sentences.zh: 周末，塔利班武装分子袭击了阿富汗首都喀布尔的一家豪华酒店，造成至少18人死亡，几乎全部是外国人。

sentences.en: The 14-hour siege began on Saturday night, when gunmen entered the Intercontinental Hotel through a kitchen and roamed the halls targeting foreigners and Afghan officials.
sentences.zh: 这场持续14小时的围困始于周六晚间，当时枪手经由厨房进入洲际酒店，在走廊里四处搜寻并袭击阿富汗官员和外国人。

sentences.en: It ended on Sunday, when Afghan soldiers stormed the building.
sentences.zh: 它于周日结束，当时阿富汗士兵突袭了这栋建筑。

sentences.en: The siege capped a violent 24 hours across Afghanistan, as the 16-year war there continues to spiral more violently.
sentences.zh: 随着长达16年的阿富汗战争继续陷入更暴力的螺旋，这场围困给整个阿富汗本就暴力的一天画上了句号。

sentences.en: And, one year after the Women's March to protest President Trump's inauguration, hundreds of
sentences.zh: 而且，在抗议特朗普总统就职的妇女游行过去一年之后，成百上

sentences.en: thousands of demonstrators gathered in cities across the world this weekend, with a broader message.
sentences.zh: 千名示威者本周末聚集在世界各地的城市，传达了更广泛的诉求。

sentences.en: I am speaking today, not just for the Me Too's, because I was a Me Too.
sentences.zh: 我今天发声，不仅仅是为了“我也是”运动，因为我曾是“我也是”运动的一员。

sentences.en: But when I raise my hand, I am aware of all the women who are still in silence.
sentences.zh: 但当我举起手时，我意识到了所有那些仍然保持沉默的女性。

sentences.en: The reckoning of the past year, though relentless accounts of assault and abuse, inspired calls for deeper social and political change.
sentences.zh: 过去一年清算通过对袭击和虐待的无情记述，激发了人们对更深层次社会和政治变革的呼声。

sentences.en: Together, let's make sure all young girls everywhere know that they have a voice.
sentences.zh: 让我们共同确保各地所有的年轻女孩都知道她们拥有声音。

sentences.en: They can use it.
sentences.zh: 她们可以运用它。

sentences.en: One woman's voice is powerful, but all of our voices are completely unstoppable.
sentences.zh: 一个女性的声音是强大的，但我们所有人的声音是完全势不可挡的。

sentences.en: On Saturday afternoon, President Trump tweeted about the marches, writing, quote,
sentences.zh: 周六下午，特朗普总统在推特上谈到了这些游行，写道，引述：

sentences.en: Beautiful weather all over our great country, a perfect day for all women to march.
sentences.zh: 我们伟大国家到处都是好天气，是所有女性游行的完美日子。

sentences.en: Get out there now to celebrate the historic milestones and unprecedented economic success and wealth creation that has taken place over the last 12 months.
sentences.zh: 现在就走出去，庆祝过去12个月里取得的历史性里程碑、空前的经济成功和财富创造。

sentences.en: Lowest female unemployment in 18 years.
sentences.zh: 18年来最低的女性失业率。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》节目就是这样。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱有时又让人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我（萨拉·科尼格）主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在途中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
